summary: Clearway kerb on a busy Moggill Road ramp section with no parking.

drivers.seclusion: Homes 33 m or more away, but the kerb is in open view of a multi-lane road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight on to the traffic lane beside a median; no bay or shoulder.
drivers.traffic: Heavy multi-lane arterial with an interchange and roadworks.
drivers.convention: Clearway weekdays 7am-7pm; no cars parked along this stretch.

flags: DEM slope figures unreliable here, about 2.5% on the samples

best_section.where: North kerb of Moggill Road beside the new interchange
